site.footer:
Reviews are written by Claude against a published [method](/methods), then read and published by the editor. They are one considered opinion, not a consensus view, and they can be wrong.

Think a review is wrong? Say so in the comments under it — that is where it gets argued out.

Have something to say about the method or the system as a whole? Write a comment under [method](/methods).
review.provenance: Read and published by the editor.
